scope.summary: Implement the get_body MCP tool per Section 13.25: canonical wire name get_body returns the typed BodySpec (cm on the LLM surface), the latest BodyValidationReceipt, and visual capture references, giving a no-context model everything needed to reason about and verify a body before editing (REQ-043).
acceptance_criteria: get_body(body_id) returns the full BodySpec with channel values, active recipe refs, genital config, and skeleton ref, with measurements expressed in cm on the wire while mm remains storage authority.
The response embeds the latest BodyValidationReceipt (hsk.tailor.body_validation_receipt@1) reference plus its verdict summary, and the CAP- capture references for the body's most recent capture set.
A version/etag field supports optimistic concurrency for subsequent edit_body calls; editing against a stale version returns a typed conflict.
Unknown body ids return a typed not-found error, and draft vs promoted status is explicit in the payload.
scope.risk_if_missed: Models edit blind — no way to read current state, validation verdicts, or visuals — which forces guess-and-retry loops and makes the self-correction contract (receipt + suggested_fix) unreachable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
